name: Authentik
description: Identity provider with SSO, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, and proxy auth.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    command: server
    environment:
      AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: {{env.AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY}}
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST: {{serviceName}}-postgres
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      AUTHENTIK_REDIS__HOST: {{serviceName}}-redis
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/media
      - {{appDataPath}}/custom-templates:/templates
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-worker:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: worker
    environment:
      AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: {{env.AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY}}
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST: {{serviceName}}-postgres
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      AUTHENTIK_REDIS__HOST: {{serviceName}}-redis
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/media
      - {{appDataPath}}/custom-templates:/templates
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: authentik
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: authentik
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
